verdict.rationale: Forter documents outbound notification webhooks that a merchant configures so Forter sends real-time notifications to its server or ERP/OMS when events occur. A concrete example is the Forter-signed Request for Evidence webhook for dispute claims, which covers registering for and receiving event callbacks programmatically. Missing for 10: a full catalog of subscribable event types, documented retry/delivery and signature-verification details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks provide a way to configure Forter to send real-time notifications to your web store server or another service (ERP/OMS) whenever certain events occur in Forter's system.
The Request for Evidence Webhook notifies merchants—via a Forter‑signed webhook—when we recommend uploading evidence for a specific claim, including which evidence types to send.
